newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINVEST HAS REFINANCING LOAN FROM MERRILL.
newsitem.headline: FINVEST HAS REFINANCING LOAN FROM MERRILL.

text.p: Finnish capacitor and engineering consulting group Finvest Oy said in a statement on Thursday it had signed a 525 million markka loan agreement with U.S. bank Merrill Lynch to refinance current credits.
The credit agreement was for $40 million and 115 million German marks, it said, but did not state the terms of the loan.
"The loan will refinance the bulk of Finvest group's current loans including the Jaakko Poyry companies' 120 million markka subordinated loan," it said.
"The loan will lower Finvest group's financing costs," Finvest said.
It said the sales receivables of the Jaakko Poyry companies and its Evox Rifa group's were collateral for the loan.
